note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): ABA Bank, ACLEDA Bank and Canadia Bank. ABA Bank's fee pages answered with a bot check on 2026-10-29 and weren't read; ACLEDA and Canadia weren't tried this time, for want of the research's budget. Sacombank Cambodia's Visa credit card tariff, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the unsecured Classic alone), is written in full: its Visa Platinum and Visa Classic, each secured (against a deposit, a condition the game doesn't check) or unsecured, in US dollars. The Platinum costs 100 dollars a year (as a processing or annual fee on the secured card, as the primary card's fee on the unsecured), the Classic 15; interest is 1.2% a month on the secured cards, 1.5% on the unsecured Platinum and 1.65% on the unsecured Classic; the minimum payment is 10%, at least 20 dollars; the late payment charge is 10% (at least 10 dollars) on the Platinum, 5% (at least 5) on the secured Classic and 5% (at least 10) on the unsecured, not written, the tariff not naming what the share is of; a cash withdrawal at an ATM costs 2%, at least 3 dollars; the foreign exchange or cross-border fee is 2.5%. The over-limit charge, 0.075% a day with a minimum of 2 dollars, is a daily charge the game's card doesn't hold, and isn't written. The tariff states no grace period.
